jobs.title: Graduate Analyst
jobs.jd: Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed. Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere. More about our mission and what we offer . As a Graduate Product Analyst, you’ll join our North America Regional Analytics team in September 2027. This full-time role is a chance to make a real impact early and kickstart your career. You’ll be onboarded with the global Graduate cohort in one of our offices and learn the basics of being a Wiser. The Role: We’re hiring three graduates to work as analysts inside our North America product teams, which build Wise for personal and business customers in the US and Canada. Our analysts don’t sit in a central reporting team: each one works day to day with product managers & engineers and helps them decide what to build next and whether it worked. You’ll join one of four teams: Onboarding, Send, Account or Growth. Each owns a different stage of the customer’s journey with Wise, and each is described below. You won’t be on your own. A senior analyst will mentor you, review your work and help you grow, and you’ll be part of a team of analysts covering the whole North America product. What you’ll be doing: Shape Strategy & Prioritization: You’ll help your team understand where customers struggle and what is worth fixing first. That means digging into funnels and customer behavior, reading customer feedback and survey responses, and sizing opportunities so the team can prioritize the work with the biggest impact. As you grow, you’ll lead your own discoveries and present recommendations to your product manager. Learn Launch Rigor & Experimentation: You’ll help design and analyze A/B tests and pre/post comparisons for new features, and learn to turn the results into a clear call: roll out, iterate or roll back. You’ll keep an eye on your team’s core metrics and flag when something looks wrong. Build on the Semantic Layer: We believe analysts add the most value when they focus on product discovery, not ad-hoc requests. You’ll learn to build and maintain the data models and dashboards that let your team answer their own questions, using Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow, Python and Lightdash, and help improve the AI skills that run our routine reporting. Share What You Learn: You’ll explain your findings to your team and the wider NorthAm squad, in writing, in charts and in person, so that your work leads to a decision. How we work with AI: We lean hard into AI: AI skills produce our routine work and deep dives, so our analysts can focus on discovery. You’ll use AI tools every day, and you’ll own the answer, not the tool: checking the data, the logic and the conclusion before anyone acts on it. Where you could join: Onboarding Onboarding owns the first steps of a customer’s journey: creating a profile, getting verified (Know Your Customer / Know Your Business checks) and taking a first action with Wise. It also keeps financial crime out at the front door. The core challenge is letting genuine customers through quickly while stopping bad actors. You might work on questions like: Where do new customers drop out between signing up and their first transfer, and what would bring them back? Which verification steps slow genuine customers down without catching more fraud or financial crime? Send Send covers what happens when a customer sends money, and is made up of three teams: Pay-in: how customers pay money into Wise, for example by bank transfer (ACH) or card. Which payment methods help customers complete their transfer, and what does each one cost us? Payout: how money reaches recipients’ bank accounts in the US and Canada, balancing three levers: cost, speed and conversion. What would make these payouts faster or cheaper, and how much more volume would that bring? You’ll also help track the health of our banking partners. Payment Risk: transfer suspensions and ACH and card chargebacks. How do we cut losses from chargebacks and fraud without blocking good customers? Account Account owns how customers use Wise as an account, not only for one-off transfers: getting paid into Wise with USD and CAD local account details, spending with the Wise debit card, and earning a return on money held with Wise. You might work on questions like: What makes a customer start getting paid into their Wise account, and what makes them keep doing it? Who uses the Wise card, for what, and what stops others from using it? Does holding money with Wise change how customers send money abroad? Growth Growth owns the top of the funnel: how people find Wise and decide to try it. That covers landing pages, the promotion engine, corridor strategy (which country-to-country routes we focus on) and pricing, where you’ll work with our Pricing Data Science team to understand how price affects demand. You might work on questions like: Did a promotion bring in customers who stay, or customers who leave once it ends? Which corridors should we focus on next, and why? Your first six months: By three months: you own part of your team’s regular metrics and have delivered your first analysis. By six months: you’ve led a discovery or an experiment readout from question to recommendation and presented it to your team. Qualifications What you’ll bring: Education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative field such as economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science or engineering, completed by your start date, or equivalent practical experience. Technical Foundations: You’ve used SQL, Python or R to answer a real question with data, in a course, a project, an internship or on your own. You understand the basics of statistics, such as distributions, hypothesis tests and confidence intervals, and can tell when a difference is real rather than noise. Curiosity & Product Sense: You want to know why customers behave the way they do, and you ask “so what should we do?” about every result. Clear Communication: You can explain a finding to someone who isn’t technical, in writing and in conversation, and you’re comfortable saying “I don’t know yet”. Ownership: You finish what you start, ask for help early and act on feedback. AI with Judgment: You use AI tools to work faster, and you check their output before you trust it. Right to Work: You must be authorized to work in the US. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Nice to have but not essential: Hands-on experience with any of Snowflake, dbt, Git, Airflow or Lightdash. Exposure to A/B testing or causal inference, in a course or in practice. An internship or project in analytics, data science, product or finance. An interest in payments, fintech, or how people move and manage money across borders. For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs . Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

jobs.title: Warranty Analyst
jobs.jd: MSX has been a trusted partner to leading vehicle manufacturers, their retailers, and mobility organizations globally for more than 30 years. Our unwavering commitment is to help our clients transform their businesses and effectively manage operations in the areas of: Sales Performance; Repair Optimization and Compliance; Parts and Accessories Sales Performance; and Consumer Engagement. With our global teams, industry expertise, and the power of technology, we design and deliver tailored, sustainable, and innovative solutions and services that help our clients optimize their operations and captivate their customers. MSX International’s warranty support program provides analytical and technical support to Hyundai Motor America (HMA) to help monitor warranty performance, identify emerging vehicle concerns, and support informed decisions on repair quality and warranty costs. Based on-site at HMA headquarters in Fountain Valley, California, the program brings together warranty analysis, vehicle repair information, and cross-functional collaboration to support product quality and customer satisfaction. The Warranty Analyst contributes by investigating warranty and goodwill claims, analyzing expense and repair trends, and reviewing vehicle buyback cases to identify and document the defective causal parts or conditions associated with repurchase. Position Summary Do you enjoy connecting the dots between vehicle repair records, warranty data, and the technical issues behind them? Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and motivated to turn complex information into actionable findings? At MSX International, we’re looking for a Warranty Analyst to support HMA’s warranty group through data analysis, technical case review, and accurate documentation. You’ll evaluate warranty and goodwill performance, investigate unusual claim patterns, and collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal stakeholders to identify areas requiring further review. You’ll also support vehicle buyback analysis by reviewing repair histories and related records to identify and document the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions that led to vehicle repurchase under applicable lemon laws. This on-site, hourly role offers direct collaboration with warranty, quality, and engineering teams at HMA headquarters, providing exposure to automotive operations and opportunities for professional development. As a member of the warranty support team, you’ll: Analyze warranty expenses and prepare monthly comparisons against forecasts, prior-month results, and prior-year performance. Evaluate warranty performance by model and model year, including total costs, units in operation, failure rates, and cost per claim. Review powertrain warranty expenses, including coverage under HMA’s 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty. Analyze quarterly cost-per-unit trends by month in service, including failure rates, claim costs, and labor operation codes across warranty, goodwill, and campaign repairs. Identify significant cost variances, emerging concerns, and unusual claim patterns; communicate findings and recommend further investigation. Monitor goodwill expenses, support forecasting, and identify campaign-related costs and dealers with high expenses and low customer satisfaction results. Analyze warranty repair data alongside technician training records to identify potential relationships between training gaps and repeat repairs. Review dealer use of labor operation codes and warranty repairs, coordinating with Regional Warranty Managers when excessive or unusual activity requires investigation. Conduct repair-sequence and repair-narrative analyses to assess dealer repair efficiency and potential effects on vehicle quality. Review vehicle buyback repair records, service orders, and customer communications to identify the initial and final defective causal parts and/or conditions associated with repurchase. Collaborate with Quality Engineers and internal departments to clarify technical findings and accurately document buyback conclusions. Enter and maintain warranty, claim, and buyback findings in designated internal systems. Prepare reports, presentations, and ad hoc analyses for management. Participate in training and product-information exchanges; travel, including overnight stays, may be required for up to four weeks annually. Support occasional vehicle testing, service coordination, and other related assignments as directed. Technical Expertise Strong understanding of automotive repair procedures, diagnostic methods, and vehicle systems. Ability to interpret repair orders, warranty claims, service histories, and technical documentation. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, and Word. Ability to analyze warranty costs, failure rates, claim trends, and forecast variances. Strong data-entry accuracy and documentation practices. Desired Skills Strong analytical, mathematical, and root-cause investigation skills. Exceptional attention to detail when reviewing technical records and documenting findings. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Strong organization, prioritization, multitasking, and follow-up skills. Ability to collaborate with client personnel, dealership staff, engineers, and warranty teams. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency is a plus. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Experience in automotive repair and product quality. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and develop clear findings and recommendations. Strong computer proficiency, including database querying and Microsoft Office applications. Ability to manage multiple assignments while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Four-year degree in engineering. Dealership fixed operations and warranty experience. At MSX International, you’ll apply your automotive knowledge and analytical skills to meaningful warranty and product quality challenges. Working on-site at HMA headquarters provides opportunities to collaborate with warranty, quality, and engineering professionals while broadening your understanding of manufacturer operations. If you’re ready to turn technical records and warranty data into actionable insights, we want to hear from you. jobs.jd: Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy’s industry-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real-time trading decisions and mid-to-long-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It’s both challenging work and work with a purpose. Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation. Position Summary The Model Ready Data Team builds the modeling data service behind EnCompass, Yes Energy’s power system simulation engine. We produce and maintain the model-ready datasets for North American power systems (generators, load, fuels, transmission, emissions, reserves, and more) that form the baseline for customers’ modeling ecosystems, along with the assumptions documentation that explains every input. We bridge Yes Energy’s Data Platform and Modeling disciplines by translating power system data and historical reports into modeling inputs and supporting the development of proprietary nodal LMP forecasts. As a Power Market Data & Modeling Analyst you will build, validate, and automate those datasets while developing expertise in one or more power markets. jobs.title: Economist, Macro & Economic Insights
jobs.jd:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.



The Economics Team uses economic research and data science to deepen our understanding of economic, credit, and financial trends. We combine rigorous empirical analysis with clear communication to inform decisions across and beyond Plaid.



You will conduct applied economic research, develop reliable analytical methods, and turn complex findings into clear, useful insights. Working with economists and data scientists, you will own research projects from question framing and data preparation through validation and written communication. This is a hands-on role for an economist who enjoys working with large datasets, exercising sound judgment, and explaining evidence and limitations to a range of audiences. You will have opportunities to develop a research specialty and take on broader ownership as the team grows.



We're guided by our principles including impact, growing together, embracing openness and positivity, and inventing tomorrow; we're looking for leaders who are motivated by those same principles






Responsibilities

 - Investigating economic questions and trends through rigorous empirical research, from framing the question through analysis, validation, and communication

 - Working with large, complex datasets to develop reliable measures and reproducible analytical workflows

 - Evaluating findings against established research and public benchmarks, assessing data quality and representativeness, and clearly communicating uncertainty and limitations

 - Applying econometric and time-series methods to test hypotheses, assess robustness, and distinguish meaningful patterns from noise

 - Writing clear research briefs and presenting findings to technical and nontechnical audiences; partnering with colleagues across research, data science, and the business to identify useful questions and inform decisions






Qualifications

 - PhD in economics or a related empirical field, or a Master's plus 4+ years of relevant applied experience, with strong empirical training. Exceptional candidates completing their PhD in 2027 are welcome; relevant research includes applied macroeconomics, household or behavioral finance, fintech, and financial regulation

 - Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience independently analyzing large, complex datasets and building reproducible analytical workflows

 - Strong econometric and time-series modeling skills, with experience applying these methods to economic questions and assessing robustness

 - Excellent writing for non-academic audiences, demonstrated through policy memos, market commentary, or research briefs. You can explain and defend your methods, findings, and limitations to technical and nontechnical audiences

 - Sound research judgment: you distinguish evidence from interpretation, communicate uncertainty, and scope claims to what the data supports

 - Nice to have: experience conducting applied economic research in fintech, finance, a research institute, or a public-sector organization; prior ownership of a recurring research publication

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for someone to join our team in Revenue Strategy & Operations and play a key role in scaling our go-to-market operations. This role is at the intersection of technical problem-solving and operational excellence, focusing on building and maintaining tools, automations, and dashboards that empower our sales, data, and product teams to execute with precision.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate across functions to design and implement systems that streamline sales processes, enhance decision-making, and drive growth. The GTM Strategy and Operations team operates as strategic advisors to key cross-functional partners, podded by functional area (pre- vs. post-sale) to drive revenue acceleration, insights, and business growth. This is an exciting opportunity to bring technical and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, impactful environment.

Each Revenue Strategy & Operations team member serves as a dedicated partner to a specific go-to-market function, whether that's SDRs, AEs, Partnerships, or Account Management.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

 - E2E Process Management - Build and maintain strategic automations and standardized processes that support cross-functional teams and promote consistency and adoption.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive initiatives that enhance revenue generation and operational effectiveness.

 - Leadership Partnership - Serve as a trusted partner to leadership, providing strategic insights, actionable recommendations, and performance reporting.

 - Experimentation - Develop and test new ideas, workflows, and sources that improve critical levers within each functional area.

 - Data-Driven Strategy - Oversee analytics and performance analyses across their associated functions. Identify areas of opportunity and acceleration; build dashboards and insights that inform experimentation and guide lever improvement.

 - Reporting & Analytics - Lead the design and management of dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and enhance team performance.

Who you are

We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You’ll strive with us if you:



 - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech.

 - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead.

 - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset.

 - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

 - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

What you bring

 - 4+ years of Revenue Operations at high-growth technology companies

 - Proven track record of developing and implementing end-to-end solutions, from data collection and analysis to execution.

 - Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps

 - Strong analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL and data visualization using BI tools (e.g. Sigma)

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

 - Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

 - Strong coachability and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges.



What we offer

 - High-velocity innovation: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - A truly global team: Collaboration with teammates across 30+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)

 - Remote first: We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.

 - Continuous growth: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.jd:
Who We Are

Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai http://ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/ontic-technologies/.

Who You Are
We are hiring a dedicated Analytics Engineer to help build and scale the data and AI foundation of our enterprise SaaS business.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of AI & Analytics within our centralized Operations organization, this is a highly hands-on role focused on architecting scalable analytics systems and AI-enabled workflows that power decision-making across the company.

You will design the core data models, architecture, and reusable assets that serve Product, Engineering & Design — while helping redefine what an analytics function looks like in the age of AI.

This is a foundational hire with high ownership and long-term growth potential.

What You'll Do

1. Enterprise Data Modeling & Architecture

 - Design and maintain scalable dbt data models in Snowflake that serve as trusted sources of truth across the business

 - Architect data pipelines and transformation workflows using Fivetran and modern ELT practices

 - Develop durable, extensible data assets that evolve as the company scales

 - Establish modeling standards, documentation practices, and governance frameworks

 - Partner with RevOps and Finance to define and operationalize core SaaS metrics (ARR, retention, expansion, pipeline, etc.)
   

2. AI-Enabled Systems & Workflow Integration

 - Build data foundations that power internal AI applications and LLM-enabled workflows

 - Prototype and productionize AI-driven operational use cases

 - Integrate analytics and AI into everyday workflows using tools such as Notion, Cursor, Glean, and other emerging platforms

 - Design systems that embed data directly into operational processes — not just dashboards
   

3. Cross-Functional Analytics Infrastructure

 - Partner with leaders across Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Engineering to translate business needs into scalable technical systems

 - Create reusable data assets that enable activation via Hightouch and analysis via Omni

 - Ensure architecture is scalable, secure, and adaptable to evolving enterprise requirements
   

Our Stack

Analytics: Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Hightouch, Omni
AI & Knowledge Systems: Notion, Cursor, Glean

Experience with these tools is helpful but not required. Strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly learn new technologies matter more than prior tool exposure.



What We’re Looking For

 - 3-6 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar hands-on roles

 - Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of modern data modeling (dimensional modeling, transformations, data contracts, etc.)

 - Experience building in cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.)

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving, evolving AI tooling landscape

 - Systems-level thinker who designs for scalability, extensibility, and flexibility

 - Naturally curious and energized by solving ambiguous problems

jobs.title: Founding Data Scientist, Capacity & Pricing Optimization
jobs.jd:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.


THE ROLE:

GPUs are the most expensive and supply-constrained input in AI. Our ability to effectively deploy them towards our customer demand is one of the critical inputs to our growth. We're hiring our first Data Scientist to build and own the quantitative models that drive pricing, packaging, and capacity allocation in order to optimize capacity and balance supply with demand.

The ideal candidate brings expertise at the intersection of operations research and economics with the ability to both model our market, build dynamic pricing models, and design experiments and causal studies. This is a hands-on role: you'll write production-quality code, ship models that drive real decisions, and bring an true ownership mentality to help set priorities in addition to executing on them.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON:




SUPPLY/DEMAND MODELING

 - Build fill-rate models for serverless inference, balancing utilization against performance and latency targets.

 - Model how traffic is shared and multiplexed across models and customers to set safe capacity buffers.


PRICING OPTIMIZATION

 - Design pricing for low-utilization capacity, including spot and preemptible offerings, off-peak and overnight windows, and sub-scale capacity pools.

 - Develop pricing policies to optimize our capacity utilization and price-yield.

 - Design execute experiments and causal studies to estimate elasticity across customer segments, models, and products.


GPU MIX OPTIMIZATION

 - Optimize the model-hardware matching across GPU generations, vendors, clouds, and regions, accounting for workload fit, substitution, and lead times.

 - Optimize our capacity across commitment types and terms, quantifying the tradeoff between cost, flexibility, and utilization risk to guide how we source capacity.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Master’s degree in Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field with 7+ years of hands-on experience in pricing, revenue management, or optimization. PhD preferred.

 - Strong grounding in at least two of: stochastic optimization, revenue management and pricing, causal inference and experimental design, or combinatorial optimization.

 - A track record of delivering production quality models that drive direct business impact.

 - Strong coding skills and experience with optimization tooling & methodologies.

 - Ability to communicate tradeoffs and uncertainty clearly to engineers and executives.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience on capacity planning, forecasting, or pricing science teams at a cloud computing provider or marketplace business.

 - Familiarity with GPU infrastructure and LLM inference economics (throughput, batching, utilization, cost per token).

 - Experience as the first quantitative hire in a new function, building models and data pipelines from scratch.


WHY FIREWORKS?

 - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

 - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

 - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

 - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.title: Commodity Risk & Financial Analyst
jobs.jd: Job Description: Key Responsibilities Commodity Risk Management, Valuation & Reporting Execute daily commodity risk management processes, including trade validation, trade reconciliation, exposure monitoring, and risk reporting across multiple commodities and regions. Generate and maintain commodity exposure, hedge coverage, net open position, and market risk reports for business and leadership stakeholders. Maintain and validate commodity forecast, pricing, position, and market data to ensure integrity and consistency across systems and reports. Partner with Commodity Price Risk Managers to evaluate hedge structures, coverage strategies, and potential financial impacts of commodity market movements. Support liquidity forecasting and reporting related to commodity hedging activities, including cash settlement requirements, margin obligations, and derivative-related cash flows. Financial Analysis, P&L Attribution & Business Insights Develop and maintain financial models, dashboards, and reporting tools to quantify commodity exposures, hedging performance, market risks, and business impacts across the global Mars Snacking portfolio. Deliver P&L attribution and cause-of-change analysis, identifying key drivers of financial performance including commodity price movements, basis changes, hedge impacts, timing effects, and market structure shifts. Conduct scenario analysis, sensitivity modeling, and risk and opportunity assessments to evaluate financial impacts and support strategic decision-making. Support budgeting, forecasting, and business performance reviews by translating commodity market dynamics and hedging activities into clear financial outcomes. Prepare executive-ready reporting and insights that communicate commodity exposures, financial impacts, risks, opportunities, and mitigation strategies. Hedge Accounting, Financial Controls & Governance Support hedge accounting programs through documentation, monitoring, and testing of designated hedging relationships in partnership with Treasury and Technical Accounting teams. Perform prospective and retrospective hedge effectiveness testing to ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and maximize hedge accounting effectiveness. Maintain a strong control environment around commodity transactions, trade validation, market data governance, curve management, and financial reporting processes. Support internal and external audits by providing valuation support, reconciliation documentation, control evidence, and commodity risk reporting. Ensure compliance with commodity risk management policies, financial controls, and governance requirements. Systems, Data Management & Process Improvement Serve as a key user and business owner for commodity risk management and CTRM systems, supporting system integrity, process controls, master data governance, and end-user adoption. Reconcile data across CTRM platforms, broker statements, ERP systems, market data providers, and financial reporting systems. Develop and enhance reporting and analytical solutions using Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, and other technology platforms. Identify automation opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, reporting accuracy, transparency, and controls. Support implementation, testing, and ongoing enhancement of commodity risk management systems and technology platforms. Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Treasury, Technical Accounting, Finance, Procurement, S&OP, Commercial Finance, and Commodity Price Risk Managers to support commodity risk management objectives. Support demand forecast validation and volume planning processes that underpin commodity exposure and hedge management activities. Support budgeting, forecast updates, cause-of-change reporting, and business performance reviews in collaboration with Finance Business Partners. Provide analytical support for business planning, sourcing decisions, commodity strategy development, and financial performance management. Build strong relationships across Treasury, Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Finance teams, providing insights and executive-ready reporting to support business decisions. Required Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Financial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related analytical field. Strong understanding of global commodity markets, trading, hedging, valuation methodologies, and risk management principles. Experience supporting commodity risk management, treasury, commodity trading, market risk, financial planning, product control, or commodity finance organizations. Experience developing financial models that combine commodity pricing, sourcing assumptions, exposure forecasts, hedge results, and business drivers to assess P&L impacts. Experience with commodity exposure reporting, Mark-to-Market valuation, trade reconciliation, hedge effectiveness testing, financial controls, and P&L attribution analysis. Advanced analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and deliver actionable insights. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with SQL, Python, VBA, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical and reporting tools. Experience with CTRM systems, ERP platforms, financial reporting systems, and market data providers preferred. Demonstrated ability to perform data validation, reconciliation, valuation, financial analysis, and reporting in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities. Proactive mindset with a willingness to challenge discrepancies, improve processes, and recommend solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across global, cross-functional teams. Demonstrated success operating within complex matrix organizations and collaborating with diverse internal and external stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting commodity trading, procurement, treasury, risk management, hedge accounting, or commodity finance organizations. Knowledge of futures, options, swaps, OTC instruments, and hedge accounting methodologies. Experience with independent price verification (IPV), P&L attribution, hedge effectiveness testing, and financial controls. Experience working with CTRM systems, data warehouses, ERP systems, and business intelligence platforms. Exposure to agricultural, dairy, energy, packaging, or other globally traded commodity markets. Professional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CPA, or equivalent are considered a plus. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. Maintain accurate Volume, NSV, and GP forecasts through continuous review and improvement of forecasting tool. Collaborate with Commercial team to prepare annual commercial plans (IAP/Budget) for review and approval by the Regional Director and Finance Manager. Support the Regional Finance Manager in quarterly customer credit assessments and reviews. Ensure accurate month-end accrual postings through timely and correct MJEs. Review accrual adequacy by comparing accruals vs. actual invoices and customers’ stock-in-hand. Conduct quarterly accrual adequacy checks with the Commercial team and obtain sign-off from the Regional Director. MARKETING DECISION SUPPORT: Review monthly A&P Planner vs. Budget/LE and prepare landing positions for month, quarter, and FY; challenge Commercial and CMM teams to optimize ROI on incremental A&P spend. You will ground each signal in physiology, help design the human studies that test what it reflects, and build models that relate our measurements to reference measures and outcomes in small human cohorts. Our imaging and signal-extraction team produces the measurements. Your work starts from those outputs. You will co-design human studies with that team so a single study informs both measurement quality and interpretation. FL127 is an AI-native company. Team members direct AI agents in their daily work for literature synthesis, study design, data analysis, and code. We are looking for someone who wants to work this way. which applications to study first, weighing scientific plausibility, study cost, and user value Co-design human studies with the imaging team, including endpoints, reference measurements, and protocols Build and evaluate models that relate our measurements to reference measures and outcomes on small cohorts, with attention to confounders, leakage, demographic stratification, and sample size Set the evidence bar a finding must meet before it shapes the product, and report what the data supports and where it falls short Review extracted signals for physiological plausibility and jobs.title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
jobs.jd:
About the Team

Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.

About the Role

In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.

A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.

In This Role, You Will:

 - Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth.

 - Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API.

 - Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage.

 - Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider.

 - Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

 - Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest.

 - Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.

Qualifications

 - Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads.

 - Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business.

 - Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.

jobs.title: Process & AI Analyst
jobs.jd: Job Description Summary Join GE Vernova's New Ventures & Strategy team and help shape what the company builds next to power the energy transition. In this Process and AI Analyst role, you won't just analyze opportunities — you'll personally build the dashboards, workflows, and AI-enabled tools that help leadership evaluate and advance new business ideas faster. It's a hands-on, high-visibility role for someone who would rather build a working prototype overnight than write a slide describing one. Job Description Why This Role Matters GE Vernova designs, builds, and services technology that generates, moves, and stabilizes roughly 25\% of the world's electricity today. As global energy demand grows by more than 50\% over the next 20 years, the decisions made in this team about which new technologies and ventures to pursue will directly shape how the world powers itself — today and in the future. In this role, you'll sit at the center of that decision-making process and build the tools that make it possible. What You'll Get • Direct, high-visibility exposure to senior leadership and real strategic decisions • Ownership over your own tools and ways of working, including the use of AI • A close-up view of how GE Vernova builds new ventures in grid technology, energy storage, and the broader energy transition • Room to grow as this function and your scope expand What You'll Do • Own the venture evaluation process: Manage the day-to-day operations of a multi-stage venture evaluation pipeline, identifying friction points and proposing and implementing fixes. • Build dashboards and reporting tools: Personally design and build the dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into the opportunity pipeline — a from-scratch build, not a handoff to another team. • Apply AI hands-on: Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar generative AI platforms) to pull together and organize data from multiple sources, building working tools and refining them based on feedback. • Standardize intake: Create and roll out templates and stakeholder questionnaires for evaluating new opportunities, improving them based on how they're actually used. • Translate strategy into action: Turn leadership's strategic direction into working processes and tools, capturing lessons learned and recommending improvements along the way. • Coordinate across teams: Run cross-functional working sessions with engineering, sourcing, legal, and finance colleagues to resolve bottlenecks and keep initiatives moving. • Brief leadership: Prepare clear, concise materials that turn complex information into action-ready recommendations. You'll do this work with significant ownership over your own approach: leadership will set clear priorities and outcomes, and you'll decide how to get there, bringing solutions forward and knowing when to flag something for input. You're likely a strong fit if you've already built and shipped working tools — not just written recommendations about what could be built — and you're excited by the idea of helping shape a multi-billion-dollar strategy from the ground up. Qualifications Required: • Strong experience in a role where you personally built things with real ownership — for example, in startup operations, a venture studio, technical business operations, or a corporate innovation team • A portfolio of things you've personally built — dashboards, automated workflows, or AI-assisted tools — that you can walk through in detail, including what didn't work and what you changed • Hands-on experience using AI tools to build real, working solutions — not only to speed up writing or research • Working proficiency with a dashboarding or business intelligence (BI) tool such as Power BI or Tableau, and comfort learning new tools quickly • Clear written communication skills, with the ability to turn your work into a leadership-ready summary (coaching and support available as you develop this) Preferred: • Enough financial literacy to interpret basic business case metrics such as Net Present Value (NPV) and Return on Investment (ROI), with guidance available as needed • Experience working effectively across time zones with a geographically remote manager or team • Strategy or consulting background, paired with genuine hands-on building experience A formal education and Bachelor's or Master's degree in a STEM field (engineering, computer science, physics, applied mathematics, or a related area) is a plus, but we are most interested in your overall experience and what you've built. Life at GE Vernova GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. We offer a robust, competitive benefits package designed to support your personal and family needs, along with ongoing opportunities for on-the-job learning and career growth as our New Ventures & Strategy function continues to scale. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes #LI-Remote - This is a remote position Candidates should be aware that this role involves a client's critical infrastructure; shortlisted candidates would therefore be subject to heightened security checks as directed by our clients. All personal data will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our data protection policies, solely for recruitment and security purposes.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders. Self-starter with the ability to work independently, proactively drive work forward, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively across functions. Preferred Qualifications Experience in DTC retail, apparel, e-commerce, consumer products, or another customer-focused industry. Experience analyzing customer lifecycle, acquisition, retention, loyalty, product performance, or omnichannel behavior. Experience with basket analysis, product affinity, cross-shopping, or customer-product relationships. Experience integrating external data—such as search trends, consumer research, competitive intelligence, social listening, or market data—with internal performance data. Experience with digital analytics, including website or app engagement, customer journeys, conversion funnels, and marketing channel performance.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid) Position Summary Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems. Regulatory Compliance Requirements This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access. Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level Key Areas of Responsibility Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems. Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests. Data Integrity & System Administration: Reconcile data between Maximo and DRMIS to ensure consistency; execute high-accuracy data entry and maintenance within Maximo to support maintenance and supply activities; and maintain accurate supply support records derived from LSA data. Cataloguing & Government System Liaison: Interface with the Canadian Government Cataloguing System (CGCM/CGCS) to resolve cataloguing discrepancies and facilitate new NSN assignments. Data Analysis, Reporting & Database Management: Utilize Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) to conduct mass data cleanses and identify trends; develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to provide visibility into part changes and obsolescence risks; and leverage Microsoft Access to manage complex datasets requiring structured, searchable records. Obsolescence & Supply Support Planning: Proactively identify parts approaching end-of-life, collaborate with the Obsolescence department to identify and catalogue suitable alternatives, and translate LSA data into actionable supply support records to prepare the supply chain for future maintenance requirements. Chorus Role Prepare and Deliver Customer Service Minimum Qualifications Technical System Expertise: Proven experience using both Maximo and DRMIS (or CGCS/CGCM) is mandatory. Software Proficiency: Advanced Excel skills are essential (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, and complex data reconciliation). Change Management: Demonstrated experience managing workflows and tasks within JIRA. Experience: 5 years in ILS, Supply Support, or Technical Data Management within a defence or aerospace environment. Critical Thinking: The candidate must be a self-motivated problem solver capable of investigating complex data discrepancies independently. Defense & In-Service Support Experience: Experience with DND In-Service Support (ISS) contracts and experience supporting an operational military asset. Logistics Support Analysis Expertise: Familiarity with Logistics Support Analysis (LSA) and exposure to Logistics Support Analysis application software such as OmegaPS. Technical Publications & Documentation Standards: Knowledge of Canadian Forces Technical Orders (CFTOs) and government-adopted technical publications. Digital Technical Data Standards: Knowledge of the S1000D specification and Interactive Electronic Technical Manual (IETM) format. Language Requirements: Bilingualism (English/French). jobs.title: Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) Analyst
jobs.jd: Why Wellmark : We are a mutual insurance company owned by our policy holders across Iowa and South Dakota, and we’ve built our reputation on over 80 years’ worth of trust. We are not motivated by profits. We are motivated by the well-being of our friends, family, and neighbors–our members. If you’re passionate about joining an organization working hard to put its members first, to provide best-in-class service, and one that is committed to sustainability and innovation, consider applying today! Learn more about our unique benefit offerings here . Use your strengths at Wellmark! We’re growing our Pharmacy team and are excited to introduce this newly created opportunity for someone who thrives in blending clinical insights with data-driven storytelling. Also known internally as a Clinical Pharmacy Analyst, you’ll put your foundational clinical pharmacy knowledge and analytical skills to work evaluating pharmacy solutions that impact healthcare delivery. You’ll gather, validate, and interpret clinical and economic evidence in a highly collaborative, matrixed environment, helping translate complex data into clear, meaningful insights. You’ll contribute to established analyses and models that quantify expected benefits, costs, and risks to ultimately help optimize healthcare resources. More importantly, you won’t just crunch numbers, you’ll transform them into concise, actionable recommendations that clearly communicate financial impact, member and provider experience, and health outcomes to decision makers. Collaboration is central to this role. You’ll partner closely with Business Analytics, Actuarial, and Health Services teams to ensure strong solution performance measurement, high data integrity, and consistent documentation. You’ll also support formulary maintenance activities, conduct literature reviews (HEOR/CER), and help develop compelling presentations that bring findings to life. Along the way, you’ll continue building your expertise in pharmacoeconomic methods and sharpen your consultative communication skills—growing as both a technical expert and strategic partner. Critical thinking, curiosity, and an inquisitive mindset are essential as they fuel continuous learning and innovation within our Pharmacy function. If you’re energized by meaningful analysis, cross-functional teamwork, and making health care better, we’d love to meet you! Hybrid environment: This position will work a hybrid schedule of at least 3 days (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in Wellmark's Des Moines office, with 2 days (Monday, Friday) remote option. Preferred Qualifications - Great to have: Direct and applicable experience in data analytics or related field that includes experience with data tools (i.e. SAS, SQL, Excel, etc.). Strong clinical literature review and analytical writing skills. Proficiency in HRORF preferred. Required Qualifications - Must have: Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy or related clinical discipline. 4+ years of clinical pharmacy experience in health plan, PBM, or related industry which includes ability to conduct pharmacoeconomic reviews. Experience may include relevant internship(s) and pharmacy-based health system roles such as medication use evaluation and pharmacy quality improvement roles. Proven ability to organize and analyze clinical data, develop predictive models to drive business decisions, interpret the model results, turn data into actionable insights, and effectively communicate model results. Proficient in Microsoft Office & advanced Excel skills – e.g. pivot tables, trend analysis, and formulas. Technical aptitude to learn new data management and analysis tools or methodologies quickly. Excellent analytical skills, data management capabilities, and strong attention to detail. Ability to review data and provide measurable outcomes and trend measures to support and influence business decisions. Possesses natural curiosity and able to influence business decisions and devise solutions. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to accurately and effectively summarize clinical literature. Effective organization and prioritization skills. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and consistently meet deadlines while also adapting to changing priorities and business needs. Strong interpersonal skills to quickly build rapport, credibility and collaborative partnerships with peers, leaders and stakeholders. What you will do: a. Support the evaluation of pharmacy solutions by collecting, validating, and organizing clinical and economic data. b. Participate in opportunity sizing analyses and contribute to the preparation of data-driven recommendations for pharmacy initiatives. c. Conduct literature reviews and summarize findings from clinical trials, cost of care studies, and health economic evaluations, focusing on data quality and relevance. d. Participate in the creation and maintenance of pharmacy value stories, articulating return on investment (ROI), health outcomes, member, and provider impact. e. Perform data entry, modeling, and reporting to support formulary decisions and ongoing formulary maintenance activities. f. Develop and maintain tools and templates for tracking outcomes and value associated with clinical pharmacy interventions. g. Contribute to cost-effectiveness, cost-utility, and budget impact analyses by preparing data sets and supporting calculations. h. Compile and organize Health Economics Outcomes Research (HEOR) and Comparative Effectiveness Research (CER) materials for presentations and decision-making. i. Maintain positive working relationships with internal teams and external partners, supporting collaborative pharmacoeconomic evaluations. j. Continuously develop skills in evolving data analytics, clinical pharmacy, and consultative communication through active participation in team projects and training. k. Other duties as assigned. You'll align directly to our sales leaders and their account executives, owning the strategy, programs, and operating cadences that make the segment successful— from territory design and sales plays to forecasting, quarterly business reviews, and pipeline inspection. You'll partner closely with Sales Leadership, Sales Development, Finance, and GTM Systems to sharpen our segment and vertical strategy, optimize the seller experience, and drive measurable revenue growth across our Majors motions. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York City, with three days a week in the office. jobs.title: Intelligence Systems Analyst
jobs.jd:
About the Team

The Intelligence and Investigations (I2) team provides intelligence to decision makers across OpenAI and investigates severe misuse of our products. I2’s work saves lives: we disrupt real-world violence, protect children, and prevent catastrophic harms from AI misuse. We also draw on our investigations and in-depth analysis of a wide range of data sources to provide actionable quantitative and qualitative intelligence to OpenAI’s leadership.

I2 Engineering works hand in hand with I2’s analysts and investigators, building tools that expand what human experts can understand and accomplish. Our tools help them make sense of vast and complex datasets, discover and measure on-platform and off-platform risk, and investigate severe misuse with greater speed, depth, and consistency.


About the Role

We are looking for an Intelligence Systems Analyst who wants to work alongside investigators to understand difficult cases, contribute to analysis, and build tools and workflows that help the team do more. As investigators pursue leads, assess risks, and determine what happened, you’ll see where better tools could help and build them.

The role combines hands-on software and data work with meaningful participation in investigations. Depending on the problem, you might trace activity across internal systems, write a query or small application, prototype an AI-assisted workflow, improve how evidence is assembled, or turn an investigator’s recurring need into a durable product capability.

You will work closely with engineers, analysts, investigators, and other subject matter experts. Success requires enough operational understanding to contribute meaningfully to an investigation and enough technical ownership to build solutions that remain useful after the immediate case is resolved.


In this role, you will:

 - Work directly alongside investigators on complex cases, helping develop leads, analyze evidence, and identify useful technical approaches.

 - Build and maintain software, data workflows, and internal tools that accelerate investigations of potential high-severity misuse or harm.

 - Use Python, SQL, and internal data systems to gather, connect, and analyze information relevant to investigative work.

 - Apply OpenAI’s models to research, search, triage, synthesis, and evidence review in workflows that keep expert investigators informed and in control.

 - Turn recurring investigative bottlenecks into reliable tools, automation, and product capabilities that support multiple users and cases.

 - Prototype quickly when a new investigative question arises, then improve reliability, usability, and maintainability as requirements become clearer.

 - Respect the privacy, permissions, evidence-handling requirements, and operational safeguards that accompany sensitive investigative work.

 - Collaborate with teams across Applied, Safety Systems, Research, User Operations, and Strategy when their expertise or systems are needed.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - Experience building and shipping software, internal tools, data workflows, or operational products.

 - Comfort working directly with investigators, analysts, or other subject matter experts in ambiguous or consequential situations.

 - Practical experience with Python, SQL, and structured or unstructured data.

 - The ability to investigate an unclear problem, follow evidence across systems, and turn what you learn into a practical next step.

 - Sound judgment about privacy, data access, evidence quality, and the consequences of getting an investigation wrong.

 - Interest in using AI systems to extend human investigative capability while keeping expert judgment central.

 - The flexibility to move between coding, analysis, investigative support, and close collaboration with technical and operational partners.

Experience in trust and safety, security, intelligence, investigations, or related domains is helpful but not required.

jobs.title: GTM Data Analyst
jobs.jd:
Netic is the AI revenue engine for essential services who are the backbone of the American economy.  With $43M in funding from Founders Fund, Greylock, Hanabi, and Dylan Field who led our Series B, we helped our customers book hundreds of thousands of jobs across services industries in North America. There are now companies operating entirely AI-first on Netic.

 

You’ll join our team with relentless builders from Scale, Databricks, HRT, Meta, MIT, Stanford, and Harvard in bringing frontier AI to the physical economy, where the problems are hard, the data is complex, and the impact is immediate and tangible.


THE ROLE

You'll be Netic's first dedicated go-to-market data hire. Nobody owns our account and contact data end to end yet: you will. You'll define the data standards, build the models and checks that keep them accurate, and give the team a foundation for territories, routing, forecasting and commissions.

This is an analyst role with operational ownership. You'll spend as much time writing SQL and building models as you do fixing the processes that create bad data in the first place.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the GTM data model: define account, contact and hierarchy standards (parent companies, multi-location operators, PE-backed roll-ups), required fields at each stage, and the rules for creating, matching and merging records.

 - Build our total addressable market model: map every home services business by trade, geography and location count, score it, and keep it in sync with Salesforce.

 - Design and run enrichment workflows that keep firmographics and decision-maker contacts current, and measure the coverage and accuracy of each data source.

 - Define data quality metrics (duplicate rate, field completeness, match rate) and build the dashboards and alerts that catch bad data before it reaches a forecast or a commission statement.

 - Maintain the data behind territory assignments and lead routing, and give Sales Ops the evidence to resolve ownership disputes.

 - Run analyses that answer GTM questions: which segments convert, where coverage is thin, and which accounts we're missing.

 - Automate recurring cleanup and validation with our Sales Systems engineer, so hygiene runs as a system instead of a project.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

 - A documented standard for accounts, contacts and hierarchies that every team follows.

 - A TAM model the sales team uses to plan territories and prioritize accounts.

 - Data quality metrics tracked weekly, with duplicate rates and field gaps trending down.

 - Recurring cleanup automated rather than done by hand.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, marketing operations or data analytics at a B2B company.

 - Strong SQL and advanced Excel or Google Sheets; Python is a plus. You're comfortable building a model or analysis from raw, messy data.

 - Hands-on Salesforce data experience (Data Loader, Workbench or a dedupe tool) and a solid grasp of the object model.

 - A detail-first mindset. You notice when a number looks off and you chase it to the root cause.

 - The ownership to define standards, not only follow them, and the documentation habits to make them outlast you.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo, LeanData, Cloudingo or DemandTools.

 - Familiarity with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex) or a data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery).

 - Experience using AI coding assistants to automate data work.

Our values

 1. Obsess over the customer

 2. Every second counts

 3. Sweat the details

 4. There are no blockers

 5. Be self-directed

 6. Seek and speak the truth

 7. Enjoy the ride
    
    

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Vertical Sales Strategy and Operations
jobs.jd:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

About the role
