jobs.title: Data Scientist (Decision Science)
jobs.jd:
About Gen

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.  

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.  

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.  

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.  

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. 

 

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist to develop data solutions that will enable us to assist critical day to day business decisions.

As a Data Scientist in the Decision Science role, you will have the opportunity to apply analytics, experimentation and machine learning algorithms to support and enhance MoneyLion’s products with data driven decisions.

You will be embedded within the product teams and deliver tangible business value by deploying or refining solutions ranging from fraud and credit underwriting to user experience optimisations, providing convincing evidence of their effectiveness. This entails designing, developing, validating, deploying and monitoring the outcome of experiments using (and refining) business objectives that will ultimately increase revenue and reduce business costs. You will partner with Product, Data Engineers and Machine Learning teams, exploring and utilizing the frontier of innovation, in order to augment analytics with AI, rapidly iterate with configurable experiments, monitor and evaluate key developments, and understand business needs intimately to help develop valuable AI solutions.

 

About MoneyLion

MoneyLion is a leader in financial technology powering the next generation of personalized products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. MoneyLion’s mission is to give everyone the power to make their best financial decisions. We pride ourselves on serving the many, not the few; providing confidence through guidance, choice, personalization; and shortening the distance to an informed action.

In our go-to money app for consumers, we deliver curated content on finance and related topics, through a tailored feed that engages people to learn and share. People take control of their finances with our innovative financial products and marketplace - including our full-fledged suite of features to save, borrow, spend, and invest - seamlessly bringing together the best offers and content from MoneyLion and our 1,100+ Enterprise Partner network, together in one experience. MoneyLion’s enterprise technology provides the definitive search engine and marketplace for financial products, enabling any company to add embedded finance to their business, with advanced AI-backed data and tools through our platform and API. Established in 2013, MoneyLion connects millions of people with the financial products and content they need, when and where they need it.

 

Key Responsibilities

 - Perform analyses to understand how our users interact with our products and how to improve our products

 - Communicate findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner

 - Identify anomalies and investigate the root causes of anomalies

 - Design and build experiments to solve challenging data and business problems

 - Collaborate with product owners to discover new insights and understanding of business performance based on data

 - Identify trends and opportunities from the data and influence product roadmaps

 - Develop dashboards to track relevant metrics

 - Recommend ways to measure success

 - Work with engineers to improve the data collection process

 - Ensure data-driven decision making within the organization

 - Apply, develop or refine AI algorithms to deliver business value

 

About You

 - Strong mathematical, statistical or actuarial background

 - Must have hands on experience in machine learning, predictive analytics and statistical modeling

 - Proficiency with A/B testing and experimentation framework is preferred

 - Adept at problem solving using both textbook methods and novel viewpoints

 - Proficient in programming languages such as Python and SQL

 - Knowledge of data structures, data modeling, software architecture and machine learning algorithms will be an advantage

 - Demonstrably experienced with data visualization

 - Demonstrably excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

What's Next... 

After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process:

 - Online Technical Test

 - Take-Home Assessment

 - Interview & Discussion of Take-Home Assessment - Hiring Manager (Virtual or face-to-face)

 - Bar Raiser Interview (Where Needed)

jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations, Agents
jobs.jd:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Commure builds AI for healthcare operations. Call Center Agents is our AI voice agent for medical practice and health system call centers. It answers and places patient calls, schedules and reschedules appointments, and plugs directly into the EHR, so calls end with work done rather than a message left.

We sell to health systems, specialty practices, FQHCs, and behavioral health networks. The product is moving fast, the market is crowded with well-funded competitors, and the team is small enough that one person can shape how the whole sales motion runs.

You'll be the person who makes the sales team measurably better every quarter. That means owning the numbers (pipeline, forecast, targets, rep performance) and the people side that moves them: coaching individual sellers and keeping the whole team sharp on a product that ships something new every few weeks.

You'll sit in deal reviews, tell us where the forecast is wrong before it's wrong, figure out why one rep converts discovery calls at twice the rate of another, and turn that into a training the rest of the team runs with the next week. If you've done sales strategy and ops at a high-growth company and want more scope, more ownership, and a mission in healthcare, this is that job.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Set strategy and plan the business

 - Partner with the call center leadership on go-to-market strategy across segments: health systems, specialty practices, FQHCs, and behavioral health.

 - Lead territory design, target setting, and quota allocation. Translate company goals into field-level numbers each rep believes in.

 - Model capacity and hiring plans: how many reps, SEs, and implementation resources we need to hit the plan, and when.

 - Help design and administer sales comp, including SPIFs that push the behaviors we need.

Evaluate and improve individual sales performance

 - Build a performance scorecard for every seller: activity, pipeline generation, stage conversion, cycle time, win rate, and deal size.

 - Diagnose where each rep is losing deals (discovery, champion building, ROI case, procurement) using CRM data, call recordings, and deal reviews.

 - Run regular 1:1 performance reviews with reps and their managers. Agree on two or three specific things to improve and track whether they do.

 - Spot what top performers do differently and make it the playbook for everyone else.

Enable and train the team

 - Own sales enablement for Call Center Agents: onboarding for new hires and ongoing training for the existing team.

 - Run trainings whenever the product changes so every seller can demo, position, and price new capabilities the week they ship.

 - Build and maintain the core assets: pitch and demo scripts, discovery guides, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and ROI calculators.

 - Certify reps on the product and the pitch through role plays and mock calls, and retrain where the data shows gaps.

 - Be the link between Product and Sales: bring field feedback to the product team and bring product updates back to the field.

Build the systems

 - Own CRM hygiene, deal stage definitions, and KPI definitions so everyone reads the same numbers.

 - Build dashboards and reporting that reps, managers, and leadership actually use.

 - Move us from spreadsheets to scalable tools as we grow, and use AI tools to make the whole machine faster.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4+ years in sales strategy and operations, revenue operations, or GTM strategy at a high-growth tech company. Consulting, banking, or chief-of-staff experience before that is a plus.

 - You've run the core sales rhythm yourself: forecasting, pipeline reviews, business reviews, target setting, and territory or quota planning.

 - You've worked directly with sellers, not just their data. You can sit with a rep, look at their pipeline, and tell them specifically what to do differently.

 - You're comfortable in front of a room. You've built and delivered trainings, onboarding, or enablement programs that changed how a team sells.

 - Strong analytical skills: advanced Excel or Sheets, comfortable building models from scratch. SQL is a plus.

 - Hands-on with Salesforce or HubSpot, including reports and dashboards.

 - You bring structure to ambiguity with low ego. You'll build the deck, then clean up the CRM, then run the meeting.

 - Clear, concise writer and communicator with reps, managers, and executives alike.

jobs.title: Market Analyst
jobs.jd:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns a fleet of distributed batteries and the households we serve into a power business that makes money. As a Market Analyst, you’ll know how much Base is earning, where it could lose money, and how it will make money in the next market.

You’ll own P&L (profit and loss) reporting and risk tracking across our battery fleet and retail operations. You’ll build the pricing models behind what we charge members, recommend hedges, and work with Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy to figure out how Base makes money in each new market. Base already does this in ERCOT. Your first job is to do it in PJM.

This role suits someone with a few years of experience in power markets, retail energy, or a related analytical field. You’ll own real decisions early.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build a bottoms-up retail pricing model for PJM that builds upon our ERCOT model.

 - Bring PJM into our risk system and P&L reporting, so we know the margin we earn and how to buy supply.

 - Identify new market opportunities and work closely with stakeholders from Finance, Growth and Legal & Policy teams to bring them to reality.

 - Recommend changes to Base’s hedging strategy in ERCOT and PJM, and track our exposure against risk limits.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Energy markets knowledge: you understand wholesale market basics in ERCOT and PJM, including how power is bought, hedged and settled. You know how retail pricing and operations work.

 - Commercial sense: you understand how a retail offer makes or loses money. You can explain the cost to supply it, the margin on it, and the risk in between.

 - Risk and statistics: you think in distributions, not point forecasts. You know power prices are tail heavy. Basic statistics is enough.

 - Coding and SQL: you build reports and models in Python (or another language), pull your own data with SQL, and work through a problem independently.

Nice to have: experience at a retail energy provider, utility supply desk, or trading middle office.



ABOUT THE TEAM

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns the grid-service capability of our distributed battery fleet into revenue. That means building and defending the models that decide which markets and products Base participates in, from real-time arbitrage to multi-year distribution deals. The team’s calls carry real weight - a mis-modeled coincident peak or an unvetted market opinion shows up directly in Base’s book. You’ll work alongside traders, market operations engineers, and policy leads who bring the same rigor to distribution-scale energy that a trading desk brings to wholesale power.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defense and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands. PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life This practice is built for the way enterprise software actually gets made now: small senior pods, AI agents doing much of the build, and outcomes in weeks where traditional delivery approaches took months. We build digital products, AI agents, intelligent workflows and modernized platforms that help organizations operate differently across healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation and consumer industries. None of it is pilots or demos. The solutions we build run in production and solve problems that matter to our clients' businesses. As a Product Strategist, you'll help clients identify which problems are worth solving and shape products that deliver measurable value. Working alongside AI Engineers and Data Engineers, you'll take opportunities from discovery through adoption, combining deep business understanding with a practical view of what technology can achieve. The person defining the product is also accountable for whether it gets used, which means you'll stay close to the outcome long after launch. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery. AI agents are changing how products are built, but they cannot decide what should be built in the first place. You'll work through ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and help clients move from broad ambitions to solutions that create lasting impact. As part of the Digital Products & AI team, you can expect to: Lead discovery with clients to understand how work gets done, where value is being lost, and which opportunities are worth pursuing. Define product requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, and success measures that guide delivery and enable measurable outcomes. Translate business challenges into products, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent workflows that people will trust and adopt. Shape how AI capabilities are applied, including what should be automated, where human oversight is required, and how success should be evaluated. Drive adoption by aligning stakeholders, supporting change, and helping clients redesign processes where necessary to realize value. Create reusable approaches, assets, and industry insights that strengthen future engagements, with the strongest ideas becoming capabilities and offerings we take to market. You have a track record of defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions that create measurable business outcomes. While our delivery model may be new to you, we'll bring you up to speed on how we plan, execute, and assure our work. To be successful, you'll have: Product and strategy foundations Experience in product management, product strategy, consulting, or a similar role focused on defining and delivering technology-enabled solutions. Experience leading discovery, shaping product direction, and translating complex business challenges into actionable plans. Experience building business cases, defining success measures, and demonstrating value realization. Industry and AI understanding Deep expertise in at least one industry sector, with the ability to quickly establish credibility with both operational and executive stakeholders. Working knowledge of AI-enabled products, including agents, retrieval approaches, automation, and the opportunities and limitations of modern AI systems. Experience evaluating competing opportunities and making informed decisions about where technology can create the greatest impact. Enterprise delivery Experience working with multidisciplinary teams to deliver technology solutions from concept through implementation and adoption. Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence decisions across multiple levels of an organization. Commercial judgment and the ability to balance business value, user needs, technical feasibility, and delivery constraints. jobs.jd: Working at Moffitt is both a career and a mission: to contribute to the prevention and cure of cancer. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Fleet Orchestration Algorithms
jobs.jd:
The Core Data Science team builds the products and data assets that let teams across Zoox measure and improve the autonomy and operational performance of our fleet. In this role, you'll focus on fleet simulation — the environment our data teams use to develop, test, and evaluate the algorithms that orchestrate our autonomous fleet (dispatch, routing, and vehicle assignment) and to understand how those algorithms perform before they reach the road.

jobs.title: Vice President, FP&A & Financial Transformation
jobs.jd:
THE OPPORTUNITY

insitro is looking for a senior finance leader to build and run our FP&A function, and to take what is already an AI-forward finance capability into the next generation of FP&A. We've done the work of embedding AI across finance; this role owns taking that foundation further so the business has seamless access to information and makes faster, better-informed decisions.

Your year-one priorities: move us from a bi-annual budget to a rolling quarterly forecast; make scenario planning routine enough that the Executive Team sees the budget impact of a decision in days, not weeks; extend our AI-enabled, self-serve FP&A capability; and tighten the partnership with Accounting so planning, close, and reporting run as one system.

You'll own the company-wide budget and forecast, the headcount and compensation model, and the financial materials for the Executive Team and Board, and you'll present directly to the Board. You'll partner closely with Research, Platform, Clinical Development, People, and G&A, serve as a standing partner to Accounting leadership, and work tightly with Investor Relations, Corporate Strategic Finance, and Corporate Development to keep the internal plan and the external financial narrative consistent.

Based in South San Francisco, this position reports to the CFO, leads the FP&A team (today, our Director of R&D and Clinical FP&A), and offers an in-person hybrid schedule of three days per week, on average.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning, Forecasting & Scenario Analysis

 - Own the Planning Cycle: Run the planning calendar end to end, covering the annual operating plan, quarterly reforecasts, and the long-range plan.

 - Rolling Forecast: Lead the shift from a bi-annual budget to a rolling quarterly forecast.

 - Bottom-Up Budget: Build the annual budget across Research, Platform and Compute, Clinical Development, lab operations, and G&A.

 - Scenario Planning: Make scenario planning a standing capability that quantifies the budget impact of decisions before commitments are made.

Next-Generation FP&A & Finance Systems

 - Automate & Integrate: Automate management packages, scorecards, and variance reports, and work with IT and Accounting so Oracle, the data warehouse, and AI tooling form one architecture.

 - Self-Serve Access: Give cost center managers and project leads dashboards and data access so they can make decisions without waiting on FP&A.

Business & Accounting Partnership

Leadership, Board & Investor Relations

 - Clinical & Technical Accounting: Clinical development finance experience (trial cost modeling, CRO/vendor management, accruals) and working knowledge of the R&D accounting judgments that shape the forecast (e.g., ASC 730, ASC 808).

 - Systems & Tools: Hands-on experience with an enterprise planning platform, strong knowledge of Oracle Cloud ERP/EPM or equivalent, and strong modeling and presentation skills in Excel, think-cell, and Google Workspace.

 - AI at Team Scale: Track record of scaling AI/LLM-enabled capability across a finance team, beyond personal use.

Core Competencies

jobs.title: AI Finance Researcher (MBA Student)
jobs.jd:
AI FINANCE RESEARCHER (MBA STUDENT)




ABOUT THE ROLE

AI systems are becoming increasingly capable of building financial models, analyzing business performance, and generating investment research. Yet complex financial decisions still demand the experience, critical thinking, and professional judgment of seasoned finance experts.

At Julius Research, we're recruiting exceptional MBA students with professional experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Investment Banking (IB), Private Equity (PE), Venture Capital (VC), Hedge Funds, Corporate Finance, Asset Management, or Equity Research.

Your primary responsibility will be to create sophisticated financial challenges that test the limits of frontier AI models.

Your work will expose weaknesses in today's leading AI systems and contribute to improving their financial reasoning capabilities.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design expert-level financial research and analysis tasks inspired by real-world finance and investment workflows.

 - Create complex financial modeling challenges involving DCF valuations, LBOs, three-statement models, forecasting, budgeting, and scenario analysis.

 - Develop realistic FP&A problems involving revenue forecasting, budget variance analysis, cash flow planning, unit economics, and business performance evaluation.

 - Construct investment research scenarios involving M&A, company valuation, market analysis, investment due diligence, and capital allocation decisions.

 - Design multi-stage analytical problems that require interpreting incomplete data, reconciling conflicting information, and making defensible financial judgments.

 - Identify weaknesses in advanced AI models by evaluating their calculations, assumptions, analytical approaches, and financial conclusions.

 - Develop expert solutions, scoring criteria, and research benchmarks to measure AI performance.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Currently enrolled in a Top 25 MBA program (or recent graduate), preferably with a concentration in Finance, Investments, or Corporate Strategy.

 - 2+ years of professional experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Hedge Funds, Asset Management, Equity Research, or related finance roles.

 - Previous experience as an Investment Banking Analyst/Associate, Private Equity Associate, Venture Capital Associate, Investment Analyst, Equity Research Analyst, FP&A Analyst/Manager or Corporate Finance Analyst.

 - Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, financial modeling, forecasting, company valuation, or investment research.

 - Hands-on experience with one or more of the following:
   
   - Investment Banking & Private Equity: DCF valuation, LBO modeling, comparable company analysis, M&A, and transaction due diligence.
   
   - Venture Capital & Growth Equity: Startup valuation, financial projections, market sizing, unit economics, and investment underwriting.
   
   - Hedge Funds & Equity Research: Fundamental research, earnings analysis, financial forecasting, and investment thesis development.
   
   - Corporate Finance & FP&A: Budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial planning, management reporting, and three-statement modeling.

 - Excellent quantitative reasoning, problem-solving, written communication, and attention to detail.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a leading investment bank, private equity firm, venture capital fund, hedge fund, Fortune 500 finance team, or high-growth technology company.

 - Proficiency in Excel financial modeling and tools such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg, FactSet, PitchBook, or financial planning software.

 - Interest in artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs), and AI applications in financial services.

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst - Network Optimization
jobs.jd:

jobs.title: Jr Controllership Analyst - Brazil
jobs.jd:

We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

The Role
As a Junior Controllership Analyst, you will be part of the team that ensures the quality of ARQ’s accounting and financial information across multiple geographies, with an initial focus on Brazil. With support and mentorship from the senior team and local controllers, you will take part in day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting, learning first-hand how a regulated fintech operates at scale and across different jurisdictions.  - Intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations)

Nice-to-haves

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Mail
jobs.jd:
For this role on the Mail team, Superhuman offers a remote-flexible work model, whereas other Data Science roles may be aligned with a specific hub based on business needs. This gives team members plenty of focus time and the flexibility to do their best work wherever they're based, while staying closely connected to a collaborative, tight-knit team culture. A hybrid setup is available for those based in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle.




ABOUT SUPERHUMAN

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company's products include Grammarly's writing assistance, Docs’ collaborative workspace, Mail's inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and automatically delivers help. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com http://superhuman.com and about our values here https://superhuman.com/company/values.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Want to use data science to shape how one of the most beloved productivity products in the world grows, retains, and delights its users? This Data Scientist position is embedded in the Superhuman Mail https://superhuman.com/mail business unit, working alongside Data Engineering, Finance, RevOps, and UX Market Research. Together, you act as one numbers-and-insights team, with a direct line to the leaders setting strategy and a shared mandate to move the metrics that matter.



Superhuman Mail is the fastest, most AI-native email experience ever built. It helps knowledge workers and teams fly through their inbox twice as fast, stay on top of what matters most, and collaborate without friction — saving users four hours every single week. Where email has barely changed in decades, Superhuman Mail is reimagining it from the ground up: AI that drafts replies in your voice, auto-labels and triages incoming messages, surfaces follow-ups before you drop the ball, and can even send emails on your behalf. It serves everyone, from individual professionals to Fortune 500 sales teams, and boasts a deeply loyal user base and a product people genuinely love. The data environment is rich, the growth questions are hard, and the opportunity to drive real impact — on acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion — is enormous.



Your work on Mail is part of a broader platform story. The Superhuman Platform suite includes Grammarly's writing assistance, Mail, Docs, Databases, and Go, our proactive AI assistant. As a compound startup, we're building an integrated suite rather than separate tools — so insights you surface in Mail ripple across the full product portfolio, and cross-product growth loops connect the dots between how users discover, adopt, and expand across the suite. Our products serve both consumers and enterprises, creating an unusually rich data environment. Our user base spans students and knowledge workers, individual users and Fortune 500 companies, universities and global enterprises, across a growing range of languages and markets. That breadth creates no shortage of important questions to own.



This is an opportunity for those drawn to complex, high-stakes growth problems — in a product people are passionate about — who want their work to measurably change outcomes.



What you’ll do

 - Be the embedded data science partner for the Mail core product team — shaping feature strategy, prioritization, and roadmap decisions with evidence, not just fielding ad hoc requests.

 - Define and own the metrics that matter for Mail: activation milestones, engagement depth, retention curves, and the leading indicators that tell us whether a new feature is actually changing how people work in their inbox.

 - Design and run experiments across the Mail product lifecycle — from onboarding and first-week activation to long-term habit formation — and build the measurement frameworks that separate signal from noise.

 - Shape the measurement strategy for Mail's AI features — Auto Drafts, Auto Labels, Auto Archive, Calendar, MCP, and the agentic capabilities on the roadmap — by defining quality frameworks and behavioral metrics that show whether AI is making users genuinely faster and more effective.

 - Figure out what makes Mail sticky: which features drive the deepest engagement, what the activation sequence looks like for users who become power users, and where in the funnel we're leaving value on the table.

 - Partner with product-led and sales-led growth to identify and quantify the levers that turn individual users into team expansions — and surface the product signals that predict conversion and churn.

 - Use data to craft remarkable product moments — turning behavioral insight into smarter onboarding flows, better feature discovery, and engagement nudges that feel natural rather than forced. This includes understanding how features such as Calendar scheduling and MCP-driven workflows change the way users interact with Mail on a day-to-day basis.

 - Communicate findings clearly to PMs, designers, engineers, and executives — from experiment readouts to strategic deep-dives — and help raise the bar on how the Mail team makes decisions with data.

You'll do this alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and ML engineers, and in close partnership with our Experimentation team (running on Statsig), whose platform lets us ship, test, and learn quickly. We think from first principles and stay with the hardest product problems through the messy middle. Mail is a product people are genuinely passionate about — the questions are hard, the feedback loop is fast, and the opportunity to shape how millions of people experience their inbox is real.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - You have 7+ years of data science experience and a track record of driving measurable impact for business and customers.

 - You have deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference. You’re fluent in A/B testing as well as quasi-experimental and observational methods, and you know when to use each.

 - You’re fluent in Python and SQL, with strong data exploration and manipulation skills.

 - You have strong applied statistics skills and machine learning skills, and you use them to drive product and growth decisions.

 - You can translate ambiguous business questions into sound experimental designs, measurement plans, and metrics.

This position will face a wide range of challenges and responsibilities providing deliverables to the customer (CVS) and internally. The Customer Analyst’s main responsibility is to provide support to the Account Sales Team calling on CVS – Including: Ad hoc business analysis utilizing systems like Nielsen and RSI Systems updating including MWC internal systems and CVS systems Financial reporting and analysis Understanding Mars’ business needs, the Customer Analyst will represent unique needs of CVS and will also help the sales team translate these needs to MWC internally. Reporting to CVS Sales Director, this is part of the CVS Mars Snacking Team. What are we looking for? Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree Minimum 3 years of CPG experience Business analytics experience across multiple functions (CMI, Sales, Marketing) and/or channels Syndicated data analysis experience minimum 2 years (IRI or AC Nielsen; Scan, Panel, Spectra, etc.) Willingness to travel (up to 10% of time) Highly proficient in MS Office applications with particular focus in Excel based skills to enable data manipulation (Excel, Access, PPT) Preferred Qualifications: 2 years category management and/ or marketing analysis experience across several categories and/or channels 2 years customer facing experience as a category manager OR 2 years’ experience as a CMI manager Statistical modeling experience helpful (SAS, SPSS, R, etc.) Experience leading and applying with broad range of analysis, e.g: price elasticity, promotional analysis What will be your key responsibilities? Updating CVS systems including item entry, contract entry, other financial entries Manage inputting and reporting on MWC internal financial systems, budget management, promotional spend analysis (included: deduction and post audit management with team and customer) Guiding the interpretation, use, and implications of analyses to improve business decisions and solutions Customizing analyses as appropriate for CVS and company Responsibility for CVS daily GSV reporting and Period reporting (shipment reporting) Analyst support for MWC internal IBP process each period, collecting inputs and rolling up for IBP call Weekly and Period CVS consumption reporting Deduction Management and operational control of the high radius system tool. Excel Skills a must What can you expect from Mars? Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University. An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus. #LI-AS The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment. jobs.jd: Primary Office Location: 626 Washington Place. Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. 15219. Join our team. Make a difference - for us and for your future. This role owns the QC review program, finding and remediation workflow, and the performance reporting infrastructure that provides transparency into underwriting quality, accuracy, throughput, and risk alignment. jobs.title: ERP Test Planning Analyst
jobs.jd: With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation & Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia - increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. In partnership with the Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) and the Office of the Director of Finance, the Office of Innovation and Technology (OIT) is undertaking a major Citywide project to modernize core financial, grants, procurement, and supply chain business processes. This project (Optimize Procurement and Accounting Logistics Enterprise Resource Planning and Data Warehouse/Business Intelligence Tool, or “OPAL ERP and DW/BI project”) will replace the existing General Ledger and Procurement systems (i.e. FAMIS, ADPICS, ACIS, PHLContracts, etc.) that support these business processes and will enable the City to realize benefits such as reducing transaction processing time and effort, providing better access to information for reporting and analysis, and making it easier to onboard new employees into these functions. The Test Analyst supports a team responsible for managing testing activities for the OPAL ERP and DW/BI project. Key focus areas include financial and grants testing, as well as procurement and supply chain testing. This permanent exempt position will transition into ongoing maintenance and support work after the project’s completion. The role involves analyzing and refining project requirements, collaborating with implementation consultants on system design, conducting initial user acceptance testing, training City personnel, supporting system integrations with other City applications, and assisting with the phased launch of the software. After deployment, the team will enter an optimization phase to assess performance and implement enhancements. Because the ERP operates as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform, the role will also require continuous support, testing, and training for new functionality released every 3 to 6 months. Essential Functions Throughout the OPAL ERP and DW/BI project, the Test Analyst will: Develop and support detailed test plans and strategies. Coordinate with development teams to ensure thorough testing of modules and applications. Work with functional and OIT counterparts to develop testing workflows, system, integration, user acceptance, and readiness deployment phases. Identify, log, and track defects. Debug and resolve software issues. Oversee quality assurance efforts. Ensure defined standards and processes for software or product testing. Provide feedback and recommendations on software usability and functionality. Participate in design reviews and provide input on requirements, product design, and potential problems. Train the team in software testing best practice. Ensure compliance with general programming best practices, accepted web standards, and those set forth by upstream sources. Provide guidance and support to team members. Completion of a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in information systems, computer engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience; Technical expertise with data reporting tools and programming languages such as SQL, R, or Python;3-5 years of experience with ERP systems, 3rd Party Applications and related integrations. Experience with implementing ERP and/or DW/BI solutions strongly preferred Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Experience supporting system, integration, user acceptance, and dress rehearsal script development. Knowledgeable about software testing tools, processes and methodologies. Able to work through the process of detecting and correcting flawed process steps. Knowledgeable about current state workflows and how these processes will work in the new environment. Knowledgeable of Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Strong problem solving and analytic skills. Some experience formulating test script scenarios: system, integration, user acceptance, and dress rehearsal scripts. Salary cannot exceed $90,000 We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply. Please include: Resume A cover letter Please note: Applications will not be considered without a cover letter. jobs.title: AI Architect - SaaS GTM Tech & Analytics | IC4
jobs.jd: LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed. Join us to transform the way the world works. This role will be based in San Francisco, Sunnyvale, New York City, or Chicago At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. The Tech & Analytics team builds the analytical and automation foundation that powers LinkedIn's most important Go-to-Market decisions. We partner across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Engineering to create a unified understanding of GTM performance. Our mission is to transform data into proactive insights and intelligent systems that guide LinkedIn's growth and efficiency. We're hiring an AI Architect to design, build, and launch AI-powered features inside the business applications our employees use every day. You'll work as a product-minded software builder — turning LLMs, agents, and AI-driven automation into reliable, well-scoped features that meaningfully improve how our internal teams get work done. This is a hands-on builder role. You'll own features end-to-end: from problem framing and prototyping, through evaluation and rollout, to monitoring in production. You'll partner closely with product managers, data engineers, and platform teams to ship AI capabilities that are ready to support an enterprise sales organization. Responsibilities Define the technical roadmap and architecture for Technology & Product Operations org, including key decisions on frameworks, tooling, and practices. Partner with R&D to build applications leveraging our internal platforms, as well as provide input to R&D on enhancements to our technical platforms and data infrastructure Lead the hands-on design, development, and deployment of scalable data products, AI/ML models (e.g., member friction, customer impact, anomaly detection), and GenAI-powered agentic workflows. Serve as the subject matter expert on applying modern AI, LLMs, and ML techniques (e.g., RAG, fine-tuning) to solve GTM business problems within Enterprise Applications in partnership with Operations, Data Science and Engineering team Design for quality and trust: define evaluation criteria, build active monitoring, implement safe use guardrails, and continuously measure AI feature performance against business outcomes. Mentor operations and analytics colleagues on AI tooling and applications, setting a high bar for technical rigor, code quality, and engineering best practices through a lead-by-example approach. Operate at scale and in production: instrument features to minimize latency and cost, maximize reliability and accuracy; debug failure modes; iterate based on real usage. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to operationalize and scale models from prototype to production, ensuring reliability and measurable business impact. Translate complex technical concepts and model outputs into clear, concise, and actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, OR equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining production applications. 5+ years of experience building or contributing to enterprise or business applications (line-of-business tools, internal platforms, workflow systems, or similar). 1+ years of experience with GenAI technologies and frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LLM APIs). 1+ years of architecting, building, and deploying machine learning models and/or automated data solutions in production environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience defining and applying AI evaluation strategies, prompt engineering techniques, and safety/guardrail patterns in real systems. Strong knowledge of responsible AI practices: handling sensitive data, access control, PII, abuse mitigation, and human-in-the-loop patterns. Experience with modern GenAI frameworks and tooling (e.g., LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks, agent frameworks, vector stores, RAG pipelines). Experience operating software at scale — designing for reliability, performance, and cost in production. Experience with observability, evaluation, and experimentation tooling for AI features (offline evals, online A/B testing, tracing, feedback loops). Comfort working across the stack as needed (backend services, APIs, and front-end integration) to deliver a complete user experience. Strong product instincts: a sense for what makes an AI feature genuinely useful versus merely impressive. Experience with enterprise business applications including Dynamics, Microsoft Fabric, and Gong among others. Suggested Skills Python JavaScript SQL Machine Learning Model Development & Deployment LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range for this role is $141,000 to $231,000. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. jobs.title: Marketing Analytics Analyst Program
jobs.jd: Location: 4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio Program Start: July 12, 2027 What does our Enterprise Analyst Program offer? KeyBank’s Enterprise Analyst Program is a multi-week training program. For those still in college, the program facilitates the transition from college to a full-time career at Key. The program provides opportunities to learn about Key’s business and strategic pillars, learn about Key’s industry-leading employee benefits, engage in exciting networking events with Analysts across various teams, hear from members of the Executive Leadership Team, and receive relevant training ahead of starting in a full-time role. At the conclusion of the multi-week training program, Analysts will enter their Line of Business and begin working with their respective teams within a rotational program within a specific segment or full-time role. Continued development beyond the program is provided through mentorship opportunities with teammates across various levels of the organization that will provide an environment for shared learning and advice, encourage professional development, and assist in the development of career aspirations and goals. About the Job The Rotational Analyst will be actively engaging with the Enterprise Marketing Analytics team, gaining hands-on experience by working on various projects across diverse marketing channels. This rotation aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the different facets of marketing analytics, allowing the analyst to develop a well-rounded skill set and valuable insights from each channel. Under direct supervision, the rotational analyst is primarily responsible for supporting the formulation of hypotheses, translation of data, design/measurement of experiments and generation of insights to inform business decisions by using various data mining techniques. The rotational analyst uses data to perform basic diagnostic analyses and assists the team’s diagnostic projects to provide answers to questions such as “Why did it happen?” and “What action can I take?”. Through the use of reporting and execution of ad hoc requests by pulling data and creating basic analysis and the inspection and control of testing procedures, the rotational Analytics Associate identifies trends and outliers. Success criteria include: timely and effective handling of data or analytics requests assigned by manager; providing input into basic business or analytical challenges faced by the team; building functional knowledge in analytical programming languages, data literacy, developing communication skills, business acumen, and critical thinking; and establishing relationships with peers and broader team. jobs.title: AI Resident
jobs.jd: Why RoboForce RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company’s robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability. The AI Residency Program The AI Residency Program is designed for exceptional early-career researchers and engineers who want to tackle some of the hardest problems in robotics and AI. Residents will work alongside a deeply technical team on core challenges in embodied physical intelligence, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, World Models, World Action Models, and 3D foundation models, as well as the full stack of real-world learning—from efficient data collection systems and simulation to reinforcement learning and deployment on physical robots. This is a hands-on residency for people who want to do ambitious work with real consequences: building learning systems that connect perception, reasoning, and action in service of capable, deployable robots. What makes this program different is the direct connection between research and real-world deployment. Residents work with actual RoboForce robots, iterate quickly between simulation and physical execution, and contribute to systems designed for real use. The problems are hard, the standards are high, and the goal is to build systems that matter outside the lab. Research Focus Areas As an AI Resident, you may contribute across several core areas: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for general-purpose robotic behavior World Models for predictive modeling, planning, and long-horizon decision-making World Action Models for jointly modeling action and environment dynamics Simulation and sim-to-real transfer for scalable training, evaluation, and data generation Reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and policy optimization for embodied agents Multimodal learning across vision, language, proprioception, force, and action Learning systems for manipulation and real-world embodied interaction What You’ll Do Conduct research and build systems for embodied physical intelligence Develop and evaluate methods in VLA, World Models, World Action Models, simulation, and RL Design and run experiments on robotics tasks involving perception, planning, control, and long-horizon behavior Build training and evaluation pipelines for large-scale embodied learning systems Work closely with research and engineering teams to move ideas from prototype to real or simulated robot platforms Explore how multimodal foundation models can improve robot capability in real deployment settings Contribute to technical reports, internal research discussions, and, where appropriate, publications Basic Qualifications PhD student, recent graduate, or early-career researcher/engineer in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow Experience using AI-assisted coding tools and agentic development workflows to prototype, iterate, and build quickly Ability to implement, debug, and evaluate research ideas in a fast-moving environment Strong engineering judgment, including the ability to validate, refine, and productionize AI-assisted code Preferred Qualifications Rich hands-on experience in robotic manipulation, mobile manipulation, or industrial robotics Experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating multimodal or embodied models Experience with World Models, action-conditioned prediction, model-based learning, planning, or control Strong hands-on experience with simulation platforms such as Isaac Gym, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, ManiSkill, Habitat, or similar systems Experience with reinforcement learning, imitation learning, or post-training for robotic policies Experience working with real robot hardware, data collection systems, evaluation workflows, or deployment pipelines Demonstrated technical initiative through research, open-source contributions, or high-impact engineering work Compensation and Resources Duration: 3–6 months, full-time Compensation: $10,000 monthly salary Benefits: Company-provided lunch and dinner, a fully stocked kitchen, and team events Premium fitness center membership covered by the company Resources: Access to large-scale GPU clusters and production-grade infrastructure, with dedicated support to enable fast, uninterrupted experimentation on ambitious robotics and AI workloads

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.jd: About AppLovin AppLovin makes technologies that help businesses of every size connect to their ideal customers. The company provides end-to-end advertising solutions for businesses to reach, monetize and grow their global audiences. For more information about AppLovin, visit: www.applovin.com . To deliver on this mission, our global team is composed of team members with life experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives that mirror our developers and customers around the world. At AppLovin, we are intentional about the team and culture we are building, seeking candidates who are outstanding in their own right and also demonstrate their support of others. About the Role We are seeking a smart, hardworking Business Operations Analyst to provide technical and operational support to our Business Operations (BizOps) team and the systems supporting our mobile-advertising business. A central part of this role is helping other BizOps analysts deliver reliable projects. You will review their code, debug existing workflows, investigate product issues, and translate business problems into actionable requests for Engineering and Operations. You will also write and maintain your own workflow code and analyze product features and experiments. You will serve as a practical link between business and technical teams. We’re looking for someone who learns quickly, investigates problems independently, exercises good judgment, and follows issues through to resolution. AI-assisted development is a regular part of how our team works. You should be effective at using these tools and reviewing the code they produce, with the technical understanding to identify mistakes, challenge assumptions, and guide work toward reliable results. Responsibilities Support projects led by other BizOps analysts, helping clarify requirements, review technical approaches, and resolve implementation problems. Debug issues in existing workflow code, integrations, and data processes. Investigate root causes and implement or coordinate fixes. Review BizOps pull requests, including substantial AI-generated changes, for correctness, security, maintainability, and alignment with business requirements. Provide actionable feedback and verify that concerns are addressed. Write and maintain Python code, SQL workflows, integrations, and automations supporting the team’s work. Investigate product bugs, distinguish expected behavior from defects, and gather evidence through code, logs, data, and reproducible examples. Write clear tickets for Engineering and Operations that explain the problem, business impact, supporting evidence, and expected outcome. Follow up on dependencies and verify resolutions. Manage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services supporting BizOps workflows, including service accounts, permissions, secrets, configuration, and deployments. Support Salesforce workflows and integrations, including programming against its application programming interfaces (APIs). Analyze product features, experiments, and operational and advertising data. Apply appropriate statistical methods, interpret results accurately, and explain limitations. Investigate discrepancies across internal systems and partner platforms. Prioritize competing requests and communicate findings, decisions, blockers, and next steps through concise Slack messages, tickets, and documentation. Qualifications At least two years of relevant professional experience in business operations, technical operations, analytics, software development, or a related field. Demonstrated technical ability through a bachelor’s degree in a field such as engineering, statistics, mathematics, computer science, or physics, or through substantial technical work, research, or projects. Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems, connect information across sources, and work through ambiguous problems. A strong work ethic and sense of ownership: you take initiative, persist through difficult problems, and follow work through to completion. Good judgment about data quality, system changes, permissions, and operational risk. You recognize which problems you can resolve independently and when additional expertise or review is needed. Effective use of AI coding and workflow tools to develop, review, and maintain substantial volumes of code. You can evaluate generated work, identify mistakes, and steer it toward the intended outcome. Practical experience with Python, SQL, Git, pull-request workflows, and APIs, including investigating and debugging existing code. Hands-on experience managing GCP services and workflows, including permissions, credentials, configuration, and troubleshooting. Experience applying statistical analysis and data science techniques, including selecting appropriate methods, interpreting results accurately, and explaining limitations. Experience in advertising technology, with a working understanding of areas such as campaign delivery, attribution, measurement, mediation, monetization, or the iOS and Android ecosystems. Clear, concise written communication. You can explain technical issues in business terms, document reproducible problems, and write requirements and tickets that others can act on. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting internal tools, reviewing other people’s code, or coordinating technical work across business, Engineering, and Operations teams. Experience with Salesforce administration, reporting, permission models, or integrations. Experience maintaining production automations, data pipelines, or shared internal applications. Familiarity with least-privilege access and sensitive data handling. What Success Looks Like BizOps analysts can rely on you to investigate technical problems, review their work thoughtfully, and help their projects move forward. Engineering and Operations receive clear, actionable requests supported by useful evidence. You resolve workflow issues, maintain reliable code, and deliver sound product analysis. Over time, you identify recurring problems and improve the tools, documentation, and practices that help the broader BizOps team work effectively. jobs.jd:
About the role

We’re looking for a product data scientist to help OpenAI create more value and drive sustainable growth for young people, families, and learners. You’ll drive product data science across under-18 audiences, emerging opportunities for children under 13, family experiences, and learning and education more broadly.

You’ll help decide where we should invest, what we should build, and how we’ll know it is working. This means understanding distinct audience needs, identifying promising use cases, and turning evidence into a clear product strategy. Your work will connect discovery and early product development with adoption, retention, and sustained user value.

You’ll partner across Chat Product, Growth, Foundations, SafeSys, and other teams, working closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and researchers. The role focuses and owns product value and growth while dedicated teams own policy and safety.

In this role, you will:

 - Shape strategy and prioritize opportunities. Size unmet needs and growth opportunities across audiences, use cases, and product experiences. Help teams choose where to invest and sequence work based on expected user value, reach, evidence, and effort.

 - Define what value and success mean. Develop an audience-specific measurement framework spanning activation, task success, learning progress, satisfaction, and durable retention. Connect these measures to product goals and assess whether repeat use reflects meaningful benefit.

 - Understand users and growth drivers. Analyze journeys, funnels, and cohorts to uncover where people find value, where they struggle, and what helps them return. Combine behavioral data with surveys and user research to explain differences across ages, family roles, and learning contexts.

 - Measure what changes actually cause. Design experiments and holdouts to evaluate product and model changes. Apply causal methods when randomization is impractical, make assumptions explicit, and account for seasonality, audience composition, and effects that differ across segments.

 - Turn findings into product decisions. Work with partners from initial hypotheses through launch and iteration. Recommend what to build, change, expand, or stop, explaining expected impact, uncertainty, and tradeoffs. Follow through to determine whether decisions delivered the intended results.

 - Build reliable measurement. Partner with engineering on instrumentation, dataset quality, and consistent audience definitions. Create reusable analyses and dashboards that make progress visible and let teams answer recurring questions independently.

 - Create alignment across teams. Bring a coherent view of audience value to work spanning multiple roadmaps. Help partners agree on priorities, success criteria, and the next questions to resolve, even when ownership is distributed and evidence is incomplete.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A record of influencing product strategy and improving user outcomes through hands-on data science, including work from an ambiguous question to a decision and measurable impact.

 - Strong SQL and Python skills, sound statistical judgment, and practical experience with experiments, causal inference, cohort analysis, and measurement design.

 - The ability to develop useful definitions of product value, validate imperfect proxies, and distinguish short-term metric movement from lasting improvement.

 - Clear communication and strong product judgment. You can make a recommendation, explain its limits, and influence collaborators across functions without relying on formal authority.

 - Comfort setting priorities independently across a broad scope, staying close to users, and moving between strategic questions and detailed analytical work.

Helpful experience

Experience with consumer product growth, youth or family products, learning and education, or generative AI would be valuable. We also welcome experience measuring learning outcomes, combining quantitative and qualitative research, or evaluating products whose value emerges over time.

This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.



The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.

 - Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.

 - Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.

 - Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.

 - Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.

 - Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.

 - Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.

 - Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

 - Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.


IT’S IMPORTANT TO US THAT YOU HAVE

 - 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.

 - Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.

 - Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

 - A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.

 - Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.

 - Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.


IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU HAD

 - Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.

 - Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.

 - Familiarity with billing or metering systems.

 - SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.

 - Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.

 - Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.jd:
About the role

The owner of Pocket’s demand forecast, inventory health, and fulfillment planning. You answer three critical questions: how many units we’re going to sell, when we need to order them, and where the inventory needs to be.

Pocket sells physical products across DTC, Amazon, retail, and international markets. You’ll monitor demand, identify stock risks early, and coordinate with warehouses and fulfillment partners to keep products available without tying up unnecessary cash.

This is a hands-on role on a lean team. You’ll work with imperfect data, build processes where none exist, and directly influence availability, delivery speed, and shipping cost.

What you'll own

 - Daily demand monitoring and the weekly forecast across channels, SKUs, and colorways

 - Reorder points, safety stock, days of coverage, and purchase order recommendations

 - Stockout and overstock risk identification, with clear mitigation plans

 - Amazon FBA shipment planning and inventory health across marketplaces

 - Day-to-day execution with 3PL and fulfillment partners

 - Inventory placement across warehouses to balance availability, delivery speed, and cost

 - Reconciliation of inventory and fulfillment data across systems

 - The core numbers: forecast accuracy, in-stock rate, inventory turns, days of coverage, and fulfillment cost

What we're looking for

 - 1–3 years in supply chain, demand planning, inventory, or fulfillment operations for a physical product

 - You’ve built and maintained a real forecast and can explain where it was wrong

 - Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with messy data from multiple systems

 - Strong understanding of lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MOQs

 - High attention to detail and ownership of the accuracy of your work

 - You chase answers, move quickly, and figure things out without detailed instructions

 - Experience with Amazon FBA, 3PLs, WMS/ERP systems, SQL, or high-growth ecommerce is a strong plus

What we offer

 - Direct impact on inventory and fulfillment at a fast-scaling YC company

 - High ownership and direct access to founders and the senior team

 - A lean, fast-moving environment with room to grow into broader supply chain ownership
   
   




About Pocket

Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.

jobs.title: Payments & Commercial Abuse Analyst
jobs.jd: The Payments & Commercial Abuse Analyst identifies, investigates, and mitigates fraud, abuse, and monetization risks across Adobe's commerce ecosystem. Through data-driven investigations, payment risk analysis, abuse detection, and cross-functional partnerships, the team uncovers emerging threats, develops scalable mitigations, and delivers actionable intelligence that protects revenue, reduces customer friction, and strengthens trust in Adobe products and services. Key Responsibilities & Areas of Impact - The responsibilities below represent the primary areas of focus for this role and may evolve alongside emerging risks, business priorities, and organizational needs. Payments Risk & Commercial Abuse Investigations Investigate complex payment fraud, monetization abuse, account misuse, and commercial abuse schemes impacting Adobe's commerce ecosystem , including unauthorized resale activity, synthetic identity abuse, payment instrument abuse, chargeback fraud, refund abuse, and the unauthorized use, distribution, or commercialization of Adobe products and services. Analyze transactions, customer behaviors, payment activity, subscription usage, account relationships, and associated signals to identify suspicious patterns, assess risk exposure, determine root cause, and recommend mitigation, enforcement, or policy actions. Evaluate escalations, emerging threat patterns, and high-risk activity to develop risk assessments and response recommendations. Analytics, Intelligence & Detection Development Utilize SQL, analytical tools, and investigative methodologies to identify trends, uncover fraud patterns, validate hypotheses, and generate actionable intelligence. Translate investigative findings into scalable detection strategies, risk signals, decisioning logic, and operational controls that reduce fraud while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and AI teams to define abuse indicators, improve model performance, and enhance detection capabilities through investigator-driven insights and feedback loops. Produce intelligence assessments, trend analyses, and strategic insights on emerging abuse patterns, monetization risks, and evolving fraud trends across Adobe's commerce ecosystem. Commerce Risk Strategy & Optimization Balance fraud prevention objectives with customer experience considerations when evaluating controls, policies, detection strategies, and enforcement actions. Provide recommendations to strengthen payment risk controls, fraud mitigation strategies, automation opportunities, and long-term commerce risk initiatives while balancing customer experience and business objectives. Collaborate with Product, Commerce, Risk, Customer Support, Trust & Safety, and Engineering teams to address emerging threats, improve platform resilience, and drive sustainable risk reduction strategies. Qualifications & Core Competencies : Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex investigative findings, payment risk data, and abuse trends into clear, actionable recommendations. Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, assess risk, and transform complex data into meaningful insights that drive informed decision-making. Experience using SQL /SPL and data analysis techniques to support investigations, validate hypotheses, identify trends, and generate actionable intelligence. A naturally inquisitive and investigative mindset, with a passion for understanding how malicious actors exploit commerce systems, products, and business processes. Strong understanding of payment and commerce risk concepts, including chargebacks, friendly fraud, account abuse, refund abuse, affiliate abuse, subscription fraud, identity risk, monetization abuse, and common payment ecosystem risks. Experience identifying risk signals, anomalous behaviors, and abuse patterns and translating findings into scalable detection, mitigation, or enforcement strategies. Creative and strategic problem-solving capabilities, including the ability to anticipate emerging risks and develop innovative, scalable solutions. Proven ability to manage competing priorities and adapt quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating with ambiguity while working independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams. Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to delivering thorough, accurate, and high-confidence investigative outcomes. Experience in payments risk, commerce fraud, fraud investigations, abuse prevention, trust and safety operations, fraud analytics, cybersecurity investigations, threat intelligence, or enterprise risk management is preferred. Familiarity with machine learning concepts, risk models, AI-driven abuse trends, or the application of AI and automation to fraud detection and investigative workflows is a plus. Experience with Python programming or similar. Familiarity with the Microsoft Office suite of tools. US citizenship is required or Permanent Residence.
